description: This file defines the FrameSelectors class for querying and resolving DOM elements within frames, including handling selectors, frame navigation, and element adoption in the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: FrameSelectors
classes.description: Provides methods to query DOM elements within a frame, resolve selectors, and handle frame navigation.

methods.name: _parseSelector
methods.description: Parses a selector string or object into SelectorInfo, considering strict options.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Queries a single element matching the selector within the frame or scope.

methods.name: queryArrayInMainWorld
methods.description: Returns a handle to all elements matching the selector in the main world.

methods.name: queryCount
methods.description: Counts the number of elements matching the selector.

methods.name: queryAll
methods.description: Returns all element handles matching the selector.

methods.name: resolveFrameForSelector
methods.description: Resolves the frame and selector info for a given selector, handling nested frames.

methods.name: resolveInjectedForSelector
methods.description: Resolves the injected script context for a selector, returning the injected script handle and selector info.
